name: Langwill
summary: Shopify translation and currency app (formerly ETranslate) with AI translation, geolocation redirects and multilingual SEO; a free plan covers 5,000 words in one language.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want their store in several languages and currencies without hiring translators, and who can start on a free or $9.99 plan
skip_if: your catalogue needs more than 20 languages or far above 300,000 words a month, you want human-checked translation included, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Plans are capped by words a month, and extra words cost $9.99 per 30,000, so a large catalogue gets pricey. Auto-translate and image translation need Growth, and GPT-4 translation needs Premium. Even Premium covers 20 languages. We have not installed it, so translation quality and speed impact are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 30,000 words and 10 languages
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars, billed every 30 days) Free: 5,000 words, 1 translated language, 153 currencies, multilingual SEO. Starter: $9.99 a month, 30,000 words a month, 10 languages, glossary, automatic currency switching. Growth: $19.99 a month, 80,000 words a month, 20 languages, auto-translate, image translation. Premium: $49.99 a month, 300,000 words a month, 20 languages, GPT-4 translation, extra words $9.99 per 30,000. Paid plans list a 3-day free trial. We have not paid for a plan.
